_description: Lookup table of Kessel implementation topics. Read by skills to offer contextually relevant follow-up suggestions after completing their primary output. Claude fetches the doc URL on demand — content is never duplicated here.
_usage: After a skill completes, read this file, select 3-5 topics relevant to the service's profile (patterns, asset_types, ui_access_checks, inventory_migration_required, tech_stack), and present them as suggested next topics. When a user selects one: (1) if public_url is set, fetch it and answer from the content; (2) if inscope_guide is set, tell the user 'See the [inscope_guide] guide in InScope' — do not fabricate content for internal docs; (3) if plugin_ref is set, read that file from the plugin and answer from it.
